column2: The host plays the Reworked version of MWCoop: you need the same one to play together.\n\n
The host plays the Legacy version of MWCoop: you need the same one to play together.\n\n

Reworked: the new MWCoop, rebuilt in depth (sync, workshop, jobs, money, network). This is the version that gets updates.

Everyone must be on the same version to play together.

Your saves are copied first (MWCoop\copie-avant-reworked). You can go back to Legacy at any time (under the version number, top left).

Switch to Reworked?
Legacy: the old MWCoop (0.95), kept as it is and no longer updated. Only to play with someone who stayed on it.\n\nSwitch to Legacy?
